data_facts_with_para.paragraph: Food in Vietnam is delicious and affordable, with budget restaurants offering meals for as low as $1 to $2 per person, while mid-range restaurants can cost around $10 to $20 per person.

facts.fact_content: Budget restaurants offer meals for as low as $1 to $2 per person.
Mid-range restaurants can cost around $10 to $20 per person.

data_facts_with_para.paragraph: If you're on a budget, there are other affordable options for food in Vietnam. Convenience stores and supermarkets offer a variety of tasty and healthy food at reasonable prices. You can find pre-packaged meals, fresh fruits, and snacks for as low as 10,000 VND (less than $1 USD).

facts.fact_content: Pre-packaged meals, fresh fruits, and snacks can be found for as low as 10,000 VND (less than $1 USD).
